review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The original PRD fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input, explicitly not a human Decision, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved material DEC-001 in B must still block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact writable binding scopes, and the required evidence stages agree with the specification. The supplied source supports implementing message-only URL redaction, boolean normalization and readonly public snapshots, and fetch-option filtering within the listed writable owners. Existing generic merging, forwarding, exports, and hook declarations are inspection owners, not mandatory edits. Distribution declarations are build outputs rather than separately maintained owners. The proposed new type-test path is included by tsconfig.test.json, and the documented verification entry distinguishes compilation from runtime tests. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the specification; their allowed agents have the applicable supplied active project-scoped capability claims, roles, membership eligibility, and capacity. The separate non-executing reviewer satisfies the stated earlier review prerequisite. Repository identity and base commit agree, and the frozen release fingerprints match between Gold and preview. The distinct original, persisted, manifest, and evaluation source digest domains are explicitly reconciled by the supplied Service provenance. Original-specification preparation placeholders do not supersede the supplied frozen preview. This approval relies on the supplied mechanically bound fingerprints and attestation records, without independently recomputing digests, executing code, creating human attestations, or consulting candidate outputs.
